messages.subject: Non-convergence in inner optimization: which options do I have?
parts:
I have a "difficult model" with problems in the inner optimization.

When I evaluate the objective function a second time

I get a better inner gradient (I presume due to starting at  "last.par.best")


Is there any options I can change to avoid having to 

evaluate the function twice?


Hans

messages.subject: Re: [TMB users] Non-convergence in inner optimization: which options do I have?
parts:
Control parameters for the inner problem are in:

obj$env$inner.control

These are passed to the 'newton' optimizer.

From ?newton:

   tol10: Try to exit if last 10 iterations not improved more than
          this.

It follows that setting

inner.control$tol10 <- 0

should do the job ?
